item.title: Hundreds of high school students in Bakersfield turn out for nationwide protests of immigration enforcement
item.description: Dubbed the "National Shutdown Day," protesters are calling for a boycott of businesses to protest right-wing policies and immigration enforcement in America. Hundreds of people -- most of them high school students -- gathered at the Kern County Liberty Bell for their voices to be heard.
